title: Sam Dutrey and trombonists Honore and Dick O'Hara
summary: They sort out the Dutrey brothers and Miller recalls trombonists who played with him in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

Well, last time I seen Dutry was in Ohio. Mm-hmm. But he was still playing trombone. He was waiting in a club out there.
